page_title: CAD 0-0 PAL | Cadiz CF v Las Palmas 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+5' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
90+4' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Cadiz CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.

90' Excellent touch by Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) is replacing Joseba Zaldua.
85' Here is a change. Chris Ramos is going off and Mauricio Pellegrino gives the last tactical orders to Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).
84' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Alberto Moleiro is replaced by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas).
84' Substitution. Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) has come on for Marvin.
83' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) picked up a yellow card from referee.
82' Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
80' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
80' The ball goes out of play. Cadiz CF are awarded a corner kick.
79' The attendance for today's match is 18950.
74' Victor Chust (Cadiz) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
73' Today's match ends for Enzo Loiodice who will be replaced by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
72' A cross is whipped in towards Chris Ramos (Cadiz) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
68' Substitution. Julian Araujo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
68' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) replaces Sandro Ramirez.
67' Substitution. Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) replaces Robert Navarro.
64' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Chris Ramos (Cadiz), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
60' Las Palmas win a corner.
60' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
58' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' Mauricio Pellegrino decides to make a substitution. Ruben Sobrino will be replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
55' The referee allows time for a substitution. Roger Marti will be replaced by Juanmi (Cadiz).
52' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
49' Cadiz CF are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
46' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
46' Referee Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' Fali (Cadiz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
39' The goal by Cadiz CF is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
39' The Cadiz CF players halt their celebrations as referee Cesar Soto Grado makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
37' Goal! Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 1:0. He was ably assisted there by Chris Ramos.
36' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Conan Ledesma pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
32' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar.
29' Las Palmas are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
25' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
24' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.
16' The Las Palmas players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
12' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
9' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and it's Robert Navarro (Cadiz) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' A player from Cadiz CF commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will referee today's match.
